steps.what: Understand the learner's mathematical question and current reasoning
Prepare the worked explanation or example used in mentoring
Mentor the colleague through mathematical techniques and reasoning
Check the learner's subsequent reasoning and identify remaining misunderstandings
outputs: assessed understanding and remaining learning needs

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} mathematical notation and worked-example formatting for explanations already prepared today. The mathematician retains the reasoning, mentoring dialogue and assessment of understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated equation formatting and example structure can add minor preparation effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native notation styles and reusable document structure remove some formatting without generating mathematical advice.
tasks.still_hard: The learner's misunderstanding may be conceptual rather than computational.
tasks.human_edge: Diagnose the reasoning problem and adapt the explanation.
tasks.altitude: Mentoring remains substantially unchanged, with a little less example formatting.

reach.learn: Separate notation preparation from conceptual guidance.

evidence.claim: Native notation styles could remove minor repeated example formatting; mathematical mentoring and savings remain unmeasured.

assumptions: The scenario includes an existing worked explanation actually used with the learner; it adds no mentoring log or trailing record. Spontaneous oral mentoring has no such preparation benefit.

The learner produces the question and attempted solution in s1. The mathematician selects references and writes the actual example in retained s2 time; missing context requires further discussion, not assumed structured inputs.
The 2-hour cut in s2 removes repeated notation formatting only. It leaves all mathematical reasoning and direct mentoring retained. Native document styles are tried first.
Ordinary author saves remain retained without self-approval. The guidance gate checks actual content before communicating it to a colleague.
unknowns: Whether worked-example formatting takes measurable current time.
research_questions: Observe current mentoring preparation and distinguish formatting from mathematical reasoning.

approvals.approved_version: Exact worked example and mathematical guidance used with the current colleague; changed claims are checked before delivery.

tasks.short: Stay current through journals, mathematicians and conferences

steps.what: Locate relevant professional journals, papers and conference programmes
Read professional journals and work through the mathematical arguments
Discuss current mathematics with other mathematicians
Attend professional conferences and consider the presented work

tasks.design: Configure native reference catalogue views in {DOCS} for current interests and conference information. The mathematician retains full reading, argument reconstruction, peer discussion and conference attendance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue navigation can take time before substantive learning begins.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic and date filters can reduce discovery effort where catalogue metadata are usable.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a proof requires working through its reasoning.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise the significance and limits of new results.
tasks.altitude: Find relevant material slightly faster while retaining the intellectual work of staying current.

reach.learn: Separate discovery from understanding and validation.

evidence.claim: Native reference filters could reduce discovery navigation; they do not replace mathematical reading or establish a measured learning benefit.

assumptions: The boundary includes discovery, reading, discussions and attendance. No new reading log, conference report or note-taking baseline is invented.

Publishers and organisers supply titles, authors, dates and programme metadata in existing catalogues. The mathematician supplies interests and checks relevance in retained s1 time. Missing or poor metadata return discovery to manual search.
The 3-hour lookup reduction removes repeated filters and navigation only; all substantive learning remains. Use native views before custom recommendation software.
No automatic digest, alert or public post is proposed. The professional exchange gate is an immediate check of the actual claims shared with external peers.
unknowns: Whether current catalogues already preserve useful filters.
research_questions: Time discovery separately from reading and professional exchange over a current learning cycle.

already_counted.description: Read arguments and discuss them with peers

incremental.description: Maintain reference filters as interests change

approvals.approved_version: Actual research claims and non-public details communicated to these external peers; changed disclosures are checked before sharing.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=97, gross 3 minus 1 upkeep gives central net 2. Conservative case: weak topic metadata retain 14/15 discovery hours plus 85 fixed: 99 retained, 1 gross minus 1 =0. Useful catalogue filters retain 13 discovery hours plus 85 fixed: 98 retained, 2 gross minus 1 =1.

tasks.short: Develop new mathematical principles and relationships

steps.what: Review existing mathematical principles and relevant results
Develop conjectures and specify finite exploratory calculations
outputs: conjectures and explicit exploratory calculation specification

steps.what: Calculate specified exploratory examples for the proposed relationships
inputs: conjectures and explicit exploratory calculation specification

steps.what: Construct and write mathematical proofs of the new relationships
inputs: conjectures and explicit exploratory calculation specification

steps.what: Check proof validity, counterexamples and the scope of new principles

tasks.design: Use native reference views in {DOCS} and established symbolic or numerical mathematical software ({OTHER}) for finite calculations explicitly specified by the mathematician. Retain conjecture formation, proof writing and proof checking; exploratory examples do not establish a theorem.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some exploratory examples may still be calculated repeatedly by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit finite calculation specifications allow deterministic reuse in established mathematical software.
tasks.still_hard: A new principle needs a valid argument beyond agreement on selected examples.
tasks.human_edge: Form a useful conjecture and construct a proof that addresses all required cases.
tasks.altitude: Explore examples reproducibly while retaining original mathematical reasoning.

evidence.claim: Established mathematical software can calculate explicitly specified finite examples; new principle development and this task's benefit remain unmeasured.

assumptions: This scenario concerns research with an actual current manual exploratory calculation component; already automated computations or purely conceptual research have no such eligible saving. The proof is the substantive task output, not a new trailing record.

The mathematician checks definitions and sources in s1 and supplies expressions, domains, cases and precision requirements in s2, retaining all specification time. Missing definitions or unsupported operations return calculations to manual work; no model guesses formal meaning.
OTHER means established symbolic/numerical mathematical software. Try its native operations before custom code. The reference view removes only 1 hour of repeated navigation, not reading.
Writing and checking proofs remain fully retained, including ordinary author saves without self-approval. Existing computation runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Whether current exploratory calculations are manual.
Whether native operations match the required domains and precision.
research_questions: Replay actual exploratory calculations and check symbolic domains, precision and reproducibility against known examples.

incremental.description: Maintain calculation specifications and reference examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=84, gross 16 minus 3 upkeep gives central net 13. Conservative case: unfamiliar literature retains all 10 reference hours and unsupported domains retain 12/15 calculation hours plus 75 fixed: 97 retained, 3 gross minus 3 =0. Compatible native operations retain 9 reference and 6 calculation hours plus 75 fixed: 90 retained, 10 gross minus 3 =7.

tasks.short: Disseminate mathematical research in papers, reports or conferences

steps.what: Select research results, source references and the dissemination venue
Write the mathematical statements and proofs for the research publication
Draft contextual explanations surrounding the mathematical results

loop.purpose: Draft context and explanatory prose around fixed mathematical content
loop.input: Mathematical core and selected source packet
loop.output: Draft contextual prose with source-linked claims
loop.check: The mathematician checks the meaning of each explanatory claim and reference and ensures it does not alter theorem scope or proof logic.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported references or changed mathematical meaning return to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Formatting is deterministic, but explanatory prose must fit the result and audience; existing text is reused first.

steps.what: Check mathematical content, explanations and references in the research text
Format the checked paper, report or presentation for its venue
Submit or present the exact final research version to its audience

tasks.design: Use a bounded {DOCS} drafting loop for contextual prose around a mathematical core written by the mathematician, then native deterministic venue formatting. The mathematician checks meaning and references and controls the exact final submission or presentation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Contextual wording and venue formatting can repeat existing results and references.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed mathematical core and source packet can ground explanatory drafting while native layouts handle formatting.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent explanation can subtly misstate a theorem's assumptions or scope.
tasks.human_edge: Preserve proof logic and explain why the result matters.
tasks.altitude: Spend dissemination effort on mathematical clarity and correctness rather than repeated formatting.

reach.learn: Separate fixed technical results from adaptable contextual prose.

evidence.claim: Bounded contextual drafting and native venue formatting could reduce repeated dissemination work; no mathematical proof generation or measured task saving is asserted.

assumptions: This is a portfolio of current paper, report and conference dissemination routes; each actual output uses its relevant final handoff rather than doing every route. Proof work overlapping task 7374 is counted once per actual project.

The mathematician supplies selected result versions, references and venue requirements in s1 and the mathematical core in s2, with all capture and proof-writing time retained. Missing references stop affected prose for manual checking.
Native document layouts come first. S5 removes actual venue formatting, not an ordinary same-system save. No automatic journal acceptance, peer review or publication commit is implied.
The final handoff gate includes the formatted version, so layout changes affecting mathematical meaning must be checked before it leaves.
unknowns: How much contextual prose is reusable.
Whether native venue formatting preserves mathematical notation.
research_questions: Measure drafting and correction time on outputs with complex notation and assumptions, including the final formatted version.

incremental.description: Maintain drafting checks and venue formats

approvals.approved_version: Exact formatted manuscript, report or presentation, attachments and venue/audience destination; any changed content or destination requires checking again before handoff.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=82, gross 18 minus 3 upkeep gives central net 15. Conservative case: subtle theorem qualifications retain 19/20 contextual writing hours and incompatible notation retains 7/10 formatting hours plus 70 fixed: 96 retained, 4 gross minus 3 =1. Suitable source metadata and compatible venue formatting retain 14 contextual and 4 formatting hours plus 70 fixed: 88 retained, 12 gross minus 3 =9.

role.altitude: Keep mathematical reasoning, proof and mentoring with mathematicians while reducing specific repeated discovery, exploratory calculation and dissemination work.
reach: Exchange reproducibility and explanation practices with statisticians and research scientists.
role.ambitious_version: Mathematical work supported by reproducible calculations and clear communication without outsourcing proof responsibility.
